name: Elbow Flexion
definition: An open-chain isolation in which the elbow flexes while the reviewed fixture holds its upper-arm posture, forearm orientation, and wrist posture. The eleven source-bounded fixtures cover three standing cable grips, separate standing straight-bar and undulated EZ-bar curls, standing single-arm and simultaneous bilateral supinated dumbbell curls, a simultaneous bilateral neutral-grip dumbbell curl, a seated barbell preacher curl with unreported bar shape and pad angle, a bilateral supinated dumbbell curl against a 45-degree posterior bench, and the exact Life Fitness Insignia SS-BCD dependent selectorized machine preacher curl. The EZ-bar source reports near-semipronated forearms but not grip width, wrist posture, or a universal upper-arm angle; those facts remain unreported rather than being borrowed from the straight-bar fixture. Brachialis is the orientation-neutral primary baseline; biceps brachii is co-primary in the reviewed supinated and EZ-bar records and secondary in the neutral and pronated standing records. Rotating or alternating curls, unsupported preacher shapes, alternate-arm incline curls, other machines, and variants adding shoulder or scapular prime actions remain outside this contract.

execution.startingPosition: Stand facing a low cable while holding a straight bar with both palms facing up.
execution.movement: Bend your elbows as far as you can.
execution.endpoint: End each repetition with your elbows bent as far as they comfortably go.
execution.returnPhase: Lower the bar under control without turning your forearms.
execution.controlledJoints: Keep your upper arms beside your torso and your wrists straight.
disqualifyingCompensations: Swinging the upper arms forward turns the strict curl into a shoulder swing.
Leaning the torso backward turns the strict curl into a cheat curl.
Letting the palms turn away from facing up changes the palms-up curl into a different grip exercise.

execution.startingPosition: Stand facing a low cable while holding the rope ends with both palms facing inward.
execution.movement: Bend your elbows as far as you can.
execution.endpoint: End each repetition with your elbows bent as far as they comfortably go.
execution.returnPhase: Return under control without turning your forearms.
execution.controlledJoints: Keep your upper arms beside your torso and your wrists straight.
disqualifyingCompensations: Swinging the upper arms forward turns the strict curl into a shoulder swing.
Leaning the torso backward turns the strict curl into a cheat curl.
Turning the palms away from facing each other changes the hammer curl into a different grip exercise.

execution.startingPosition: Stand upright holding the straight bar with both palms facing up and the upper arms beside the torso.
execution.movement: Flex both elbows through a comfortable full range without moving the shoulders.
execution.endpoint: End with the elbows comfortably bent and both palms still facing up.
execution.returnPhase: Lower the bar under control without rotating the forearms.
execution.controlledJoints: Keep the wrists neutral and the upper arms beside the torso.
execution.supportAndPosture: Keep the trunk and knees still throughout the repetition.
disqualifyingCompensations: Leaning backward or driving with the knees changes the strict curl.
Swinging the upper arms forward adds a shoulder-flexion repetition.

execution.startingPosition: Log the total loaded EZ bar, including plates. Stand upright and take a comfortable two-hand grip on the angled sections of the bar.
execution.movement: Curl the bar by bending both elbows together without rotating the forearms.
execution.endpoint: End at the top of your controlled curl range with both hands still on the same angled sections.
execution.returnPhase: Lower the bar under control so the complete up-and-down repetition lasts about three seconds.
execution.controlledJoints: Keep the wrists steady and move both elbows together.
execution.supportAndPosture: Keep the trunk and knees still without external support.
disqualifyingCompensations: Using a straight bar changes the implement and hand angle.
Rotating or alternating the arms changes the simultaneous fixed-grip curl.
Leaning backward or driving with the knees changes the strict curl.

execution.startingPosition: Stand with one dumbbell in the working hand, the palm facing up, and the upper arm alongside the body.
execution.movement: Flex the working elbow through a comfortable range without moving the shoulder.
execution.endpoint: End with the elbow comfortably flexed and the palm still facing up.
execution.returnPhase: Lower the dumbbell under control toward the near-extended start.
execution.controlledJoints: Keep the palm up, wrist neutral, and upper arm beside the torso.
execution.supportAndPosture: Keep the trunk and lower body still against the one-sided load.
disqualifyingCompensations: Leaning or twisting the torso changes the strict curl.
Swinging the upper arm forward or rotating the palm changes the reviewed fixture.
execution.sideOrDirection: Complete the set on one arm, then repeat with the other arm.

execution.startingPosition: Sit at a preacher station with both upper arms fully supported on the pad, hold the source-described bar with palms up, and keep the wrists neutral.
execution.movement: Flex both elbows together for one second without lifting the upper arms from the pad.
execution.endpoint: Finish at the top of the controlled elbow-flexion range while the upper arms remain supported.
execution.returnPhase: Lower the bar for two seconds to the controlled start without changing forearm orientation.
execution.controlledJoints: Create the repetition through elbow flexion while the wrists and forearm orientation stay fixed.
execution.supportAndPosture: Keep both upper arms on the preacher pad; the source does not report a bar shape or pad angle.
disqualifyingCompensations: Lifting an upper arm from the pad leaves the reviewed preacher fixture.
Using an alternate-arm sequence or rotating the forearms changes the reviewed task.
Treating the unreported bar as a confirmed straight or EZ bar invents fixture detail.

execution.startingPosition: Log one dumbbell's weight, not the pair total. Recline against a 45-degree bench with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing up, and both upper arms hanging behind the torso.
execution.movement: Flex both elbows together while keeping the torso supported and the upper-arm position unchanged.
execution.endpoint: Finish at the top of the controlled elbow-flexion range with both palms still facing up.
execution.returnPhase: Lower both dumbbells together under control until the elbows approach extension.
execution.controlledJoints: Create the repetition through elbow flexion without rotating the forearms or deliberately flexing the shoulders.
execution.supportAndPosture: Keep the torso against the bench and move both arms at the same time.
disqualifyingCompensations: Sitting upright or losing posterior bench support leaves the reviewed incline fixture.
Alternating arms changes the reviewed two-arm sequence.
Swinging the upper arms forward adds shoulder motion outside the family contract.

execution.movement: Flex both elbows together without moving the shoulders.

execution.returnPhase: Lower both dumbbells together under control toward elbow extension.
execution.controlledJoints: Keep both palms facing up, both wrists neutral, and the upper arms beside the torso.
execution.supportAndPosture: Keep the trunk and lower body still.

Leaning backward or driving with the knees changes the strict curl.

execution.movement: Flex both elbows together without turning the forearms.
execution.endpoint: Finish at the top of the controlled range with both palms still facing inward.
execution.returnPhase: Lower both dumbbells together under control toward elbow extension.
execution.controlledJoints: Keep both forearms neutral, both wrists straight, and the upper arms beside the torso.
execution.supportAndPosture: Keep the trunk and lower body still.
disqualifyingCompensations: Alternating the arms leaves the simultaneous two-arm fixture.
Leaning backward or driving with the knees changes the strict curl.
Turning the palms or swinging the upper arms changes the reviewed hammer curl.

exercises.name: Machine Preacher Curl
aliases: Life Fitness Insignia Series Biceps Curl - Dependent

execution.startingPosition: Compare the entered load only on this same Life Fitness Insignia SS-BCD fixture. Sit down, adjust the seat so the backs of both upper arms rest fully on the arm pad, align the elbows with the machine pivot, and take the handles with palms up from the straight-arm start.
execution.movement: Curl both dependent handles toward the upper arms while keeping both elbows on the pad.
execution.endpoint: Briefly hold the top position with both elbows flexed and both upper arms fully supported.
execution.returnPhase: Lower the handles slowly to the straight-arm start.
execution.controlledJoints: Create the repetition through simultaneous elbow flexion while keeping the palms up; the source does not specify a wrist posture.
execution.supportAndPosture: Keep both upper arms against the pad and maintain the seated setup throughout the set.
disqualifyingCompensations: Lifting an upper arm from the pad leaves the reviewed machine fixture.
Alternating the handles or rotating the forearms changes the dependent palms-up task.
Using another machine model, independent arms, or a plate-loaded mechanism changes the load history and fixture.
